summary: Design a 12–36-month workforce reinvention blueprint linking skills sensing, internal mobility and career pathways. Explore the course and plan your next step.
lede: Continuous career reinvention helps HR and business leaders align workforce capabilities and career options with changing work. Participants practise skills-gap assessment, adjacent-role pathway design and internal mobility planning, alongside supportive conversations about role changes. The work culminates in a sequenced 12–36-month blueprint, with AI-assisted skills inference and human-capital reporting covered at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and specialists who shape workforce capability, career movement and people transitions. It suits professionals with working exposure to HR, talent, learning or business planning.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of HR, talent management, learning and development, workforce planning or business-unit people decisions is expected. No coding or programming is required.
